title: tasklist: a small to-do list tool

text.1: tasklist is a small program that keeps a to-do list in a file on your computer.
text.3: tasklist is a command-line to-do list. It offers add, list and done, and keeps its tasks in one JSON file.
text.5: tasklist is a standard-library Python CLI with add, list and done commands; cli.py parses arguments and store.py persists tasks to a single JSON file.

body.1: This repository holds a small program for keeping a to-do list. You type a short command and it remembers your tasks.
body.3: The repository is a to-do list command-line tool. Its README names three commands, add, list and done, and says tasks are stored in tasks.json in the current directory.
body.5: The repository packages a standard-library Python CLI under src/tasklist. The README lists add, list and done, and the agent notes say commands live in cli.py and file handling in store.py.
